author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
Confirmed bug — filed PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#8241 with diagnosis and proposed fix.

**Diagnosis**: PE correctly computes household resources ($73,288) but doesn't gate the credit on the MI-1040CR line 33 income limit ($71,500 for 2025). The senior-renter Worksheet 5 path then leaks the $1,900 max because it legitimately bypasses the standard Table B phase-out (per form). TaxAct correctly returns $0 due to the line 33 STOP.

**Fix**: add a household-resources eligibility gate ($69,700 for 2024, $71,500 for 2025), matching the form's line 33 STOP rule and aligning with MCL 206.520(8) statutory phase-out endpoint.
